memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "After you have written descriptions of the seven parts of the land, bring them here to me and I will cast lots for you in the presence of the Lord our God. The Levites, however, do not get a portion among you, because the priestly service of the Lord is their inheritance. And Gad, Reuben and the half-tribe of Manasseh have already received their inheritance on the east side of the Jordan. Moses the servant of the Lord gave it to them." - Josh 18:6-7 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Joshua explains that the lots will be cast "in the presence of the Lord our God." Even the method of dividing the land was placed before God, trusting Him to assign each portion. And once more the Levites are singled out: they receive no land, "because the priestly service of the Lord is their inheritance." For the Levites, serving God was itself their portion.

That phrase is worth holding onto: the service of the Lord was their inheritance. While others received fields and towns, the Levites received the privilege of drawing near to God in worship and ministry. What looked like being left out was actually being given the greatest treasure — nearness to God and a life devoted to Him. To serve the Lord was not their loss; it was their reward.

This reframes how we think about serving God. We can treat serving Him as a duty that costs us, something we give up our time and comfort to do. But the Levites saw it differently: serving God was the inheritance itself, the privilege that outshone land and possessions. In Christ, all of us are now brought near and made a royal priesthood (1 Pet 2:9). To know God and to serve Him is not a burden we bear but the richest portion we could receive. When serving God feels costly, remember the Levites: His service is our inheritance.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do you view serving God as a costly duty or a rich privilege?
- How would it change your service to see it as your inheritance?
- What does it mean that in Christ you are part of a royal priesthood?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, forgive me when I treat serving You as a burden. Help me to see, like the Levites, that knowing and serving You is my greatest inheritance and deepest joy. Amen.
